entities.summary: Tábua, officially the Town of Tábua (Portuguese: Vila de Tábua, is a town and municipality of the Coimbra District, in Portugal. In 2021 it had 11,160 inhabitants, in an area of 199.79 square kilometres. The town of Tábua is contained within a civil parish with 3,681 inhabitants as of 2021.
